draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for the note -- glad the first few days have gone smoothly, and it's completely normal to still be finding your way around the layout.

One thing that helps it click: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a single real project with a few real tasks usually shows what Wrenfield is for. Whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project together and answer anything about the layout.

Best,
Nadia
